_comment: Corrections to how Sleeper logged trades, confirmed by Riley on 2026-10-10. Each entry is keyed by the Sleeper transaction_id of the main trade. absorb = other logged transactions that are really part of it. add_picks = picks that were part of the deal but moved later by the commissioner because the app could not hold them yet. draft_credit = draft picks to credit to a different franchise than the one that clicked the pick. conditional_swap = picks whose final owner depends on where they land. notes are shown on the trade page.

notes: Jameson Williams was left out when the trade was submitted and was sent in a follow-up 78 minutes later.
The 2028 and 2029 first-round picks were part of the deal from the start. Sleeper could not hold picks that far out, so the commissioner assigned each when its draft year opened.
[[f:9]]'s 2028 fourth-round pick was part of the deal. Sleeper could not hold a pick that far out, so the commissioner assigned it on 2025-08-17.
Condition: [[f:9]] could not trade the 1.02 pick or use it on a quarterback.

Agreed before the 2025 rookie draft and executed as it began. [[f:9]] received pick 1.03 (Omarion Hampton); [[f:7]] received pick 1.08 (Quinshon Judkins), Jaylen Warren and a 2027 first. Sleeper had already locked the draft board, so each team made the other's pick and the commissioner swapped the two players afterwards.
Conditional pick swap: of the 2027 second-round picks originally belonging to [[f:4]] and [[f:2]], the better goes to [[f:3]] and the worse to [[f:6]].
